figurative_meaning_en: To fall into trouble or distress
example_sentences_in_bangla: এই সিদ্ধান্তের কারণে আমি গাড্ডায় পড়েছি।
ব্যবসায়ের লোভে সে ঋণের গাড্ডায় পড়েছে।
example_sentences_in_english: I've fallen into a pit of trouble because of this decision.
He got into a financial hole due to his greed for business.
note: This idiom evokes imagery of rural pitfalls, commonly used in spoken Bengali to describe sudden misfortunes.
